lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice explaining a past plan with weather as the reason.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Monday small talk about how weather changed weekend activities.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Giving a reason for a past decision.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about weekend plans that changed because it rained or became sunny.

main_focus.name: past narration with a reason clause
main_focus.description: Use a simple past-tense sentence plus därför att or för att to explain why something happened.
model_examples: Vi stannade hemma därför att det regnade.
Jag gick ut för att solen sken.
Vi ändrade planen därför att det blev kallt.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use past-tense reason clauses naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic modal verbs: kan, vill, ska
one simple reason clause with för att or därför att

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use weather words as the reason for concrete past choices.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks how the weekend plan went.
dialogue_shape.middle: They describe a weather change and explain the decision it caused.
dialogue_shape.ending: They end by saying whether the changed plan was still okay.

target_complexity.repetition: reuse past tense and reason clauses from earlier lessons

focus: the original or expected weekend plan
the weather reason that changed the plan
the outcome after the plan changed

sentence_focus: one sentence with därför att and weather
one sentence with stannade hemma or gick ut
one sentence saying the outcome was still good
